name: Generate Tiling UVs
explanation_long: Creates tiling UVs by applying cube unwrapping also known as box mapping. Materials are replaced with a Default Material and UVs are not packed into an atlas and are therefore not intended to be used for texture baking. Warning: This overrides existing UV sets and might therefore lead to issues with existing Texture Sets.

exposed_options.description_long: Scale factor for the cube UVs (box mapping). Higher values scale up the individual UVs which, depending on the material and texture leads to a higher tiling ratio (density) across the surface.
